Problems Faced by Pakistani Businesses

Pakistani businesses face numerous challenges when it comes to FBR compliance. One of the major issues is the lack of awareness about FBR regulations and the consequences of non-compliance. Non-compliance can result in heavy penalties, fines, and even business closure.

Another challenge is the complexity of FBR laws and regulations. Businesses need to keep track of various SROs, including SRO 1006 and SRO 673, which can be time-consuming and costly.

Moreover, manual data entry and lack of automation can lead to errors and inaccuracies, resulting in non-compliance and penalties.

Solution: Phelix ERP FBR POS Integration

Phelix ERP provides a comprehensive FBR POS integration solution that addresses all the challenges faced by Pakistani businesses. Our POS system is FBR certified and meets all the requirements of SRO 1006 and SRO 673.
